conditions.name: Alcohol use disorder

ratingSchedule.note: Mental-disorders rating framework. No single alcohol-use-disorder-specific diagnostic code is asserted here; rating depends on documented findings and the General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders.

reviewNotes: Added 2026-10-03 as staged Leg B execution of the signed catalog identity migration design dated 2026-09-29 (docs/catalog-identity-migration-design-2026-09-29.md), a versioned scope split from the substance-use-disorder discovery grouping (the eczema precedent). The addition moves the frozen identity contract 818/818 to 819/819 and preserves one-to-one catalog/KB integrity without changing any stable ID; the aliases 'alcohol use disorder' and 'alcoholism' migrate off substance-use-disorder so the substance-specific diagnosis owns its name. Closes the missing-identity blocker behind the withheld ptsd to chronic-liver-disease self-medication chain (D1 batch 91; PMID 30080255 preserved under ME-29).

Scope guards: this identity is the alcohol-specific diagnosis; substance-use-disorder remains the broad discovery grouping and keeps non-alcohol substance scope. A shared 38 CFR 4.130 framework does not establish shared etiology between them. Alcohol- and drug-related legal eligibility rules are separate from rating identity and must be evaluated independently.

This identity is ALSO the standing confounding-exposure vocabulary for hepatic, psychiatric, trauma and pancreatic routes: every liver and mood claim must consider alcohol exposure as a rival etiology before attribution.
